offering_description.value: The company develops vehicle access and security systems for automakers and helps integrate them into vehicle designs. It supplies aftermarket locks and keys through independent distributors.

quotes.quote: Strattec is continuously advancing access innovation to help OEMs integrate access more seamlessly into vehicle design and user experience while delivering differentiated solutions that evolve with consumer expectations.
STRATTEC Aftermarket Solutions provides OEM quality locks and keys to the automotive aftermarket through highly developed, independent distribution channels. Learn more here.
